title: Training-Free Bias Mitigation by LLM-Assisted Bias Detection and Latent Variable Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by computing the statistical parity of gender distributions in generated images of various professions (classified using the FairFace model) against both uniform distributions and real-world U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) demographic data.

Measured by computing the statistical parity of racial distributions in generated images of various professions (classified using the FairFace model) against both uniform distributions and real-world U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) demographic data.

Evaluated by prompting Large Language Models to automatically infer diverse implicit bias categories (such as age, attire, body type, and setting) from text prompts, and comparing the breadth and granularity of these detected categories against human-annotated reference sets.
